facts.text: The resort is a beachfront hotel on the sands of Waikiki.
facts.excerpt: Escape to OUTRIGGER Reef Waikiki Beach Resort, a beachfront hotel on the sands of Waikiki.

facts.text: The resort's address is 2169 Kalia Road in Honolulu.
facts.excerpt: Find us at: 2169 Kalia Rd, Honolulu, HI 96815

facts.text: The renovated accommodations have a modern, residential Hawaiian feel and private lanais with views of Waikiki Beach.
facts.excerpt: Our newly renovated accommodations feature a modern, residential Hawaiian feela and private lanais with idyllic views of Waikiki Beach.

facts.text: Club rooms and suites include access to the Voyager 47 Club Lounge.
facts.excerpt: Take your Hawaiian getaway to the next level with a spacious club room or suite and enjoy exclusive Voyager 47 Club Lounge access.

facts.text: The Voyager 47 Club Lounge overlooks Waikiki Beach and serves a Hawaiian-style breakfast with premium Kona coffee in the morning.
facts.excerpt: Overlooking beautiful Waikiki beach, the Voyager 47 Club Lounge offers spectacular views and serious perks. Start your morning with a Hawaiian-style breakfast and premium Kona coffee at daybreak

facts.text: In the evening the Voyager 47 Club Lounge offers premium beverages and pupu, or appetizers.
facts.excerpt: enjoy your evening with premium beverages and pupu (appetizers) to sample our island flavors

facts.text: Oceanfront rooms have an unobstructed view of the ocean.
facts.excerpt: Wake up to an unobstructed view of the ocean and the gentle sounds of waves crashing on Waikiki Beach.

facts.text: Resort view rooms look out to green mountains.
facts.excerpt: A tranquil Hawaii haven with striking views of ancient green mountains.

facts.text: The resort showcases Hawaiian culture through curated artwork, Signature Experiences and hands-on crafts.
facts.excerpt: Authentic Hawaiian culture, from curated artwork, Signature Experiences and hands-on crafts

facts.text: Kani Ka Pila Grille showcases Hawaiian performers every night.
facts.excerpt: Kani Ka Pila Grille – the Home of Hawaiian Music – showcases award-winning Hawaiian performers in an intimate setting, every night

facts.text: Monkeypod Kitchen by Merriman serves farm-fresh cuisine by Chef Peter Merriman, with glass railings separating diners from the ocean a few yards away.
facts.excerpt: With only stunning glass railings separating you from the ocean a few yards away, the experience is a true seaside-al-fresco delight.

facts.text: Activities include lei making, hula lessons and native island arts and crafts.
facts.excerpt:
- Native island arts and crafts
- Lei making
- Hula lessons

facts.text: Guests can learn to play the ukulele.
facts.excerpt: Dance to the rhythm of hula. Enjoy the best live Hawaiian music in Honolulu. Learn to play the ukulele.

facts.text: The resort offers a traditional Hawaiian vow renewal ceremony.
facts.excerpt: Recommit your love with a traditional Hawaiian vow renewal ceremony

facts.text: The resort has a swimming pool with poolside cabanas and daybeds.
facts.excerpt:
- Swimming pool
- Poolside cabanas and daybeds

facts.text: The resort has the Coral Kids Club.
facts.excerpt: - Coral Kids Club

facts.text: Yoga is offered on Wednesdays and Sundays.
facts.excerpt: - Yoga (Wednesdays & Sundays at 9 am)

facts.text: Pet-friendly rooms are available for a fee.
facts.excerpt: - Pet-friendly rooms (fee)

facts.text: Honolulu Surf Club Hawaii, on the resort's beachfront, offers beach chaise rentals and surfing lessons.
facts.excerpt: Honolulu Surf Club Hawaii is located on our beachfront. They offer beach chaise rentals and surfing lessons.

facts.text: The beach is steps from the hotel, reached by walking toward the back of the hotel.
facts.excerpt: The beach is located steps away from the hotel! Please walk towards the backside of the hotel to get to the ocean.

facts.text: The lobby is adorned with Polynesian canoe art handpicked by historian Herb Kane.
facts.excerpt: The revamped lobby is adorned with Polynesian canoe art, handpicked by historian Herb Kane.

facts.text: The resort underwent a $110 million renovation.
facts.excerpt: Following a $110 million renovation, this Waikiki resort has spanking-new rooms, three new restaurants, an expanded spa, and a rebuilt pool and deck.

facts.text: The Voyager 47 lounge claims the best beachfront views of any club lounge in Waikiki.
facts.excerpt: The iconic Voyager 47, offers premium sunrise and sunset refreshments with the best beachfront views of any club lounge in Waikiki
